approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 27 Chapter 555
 
      MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 4138-A, entitled:
 
    "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to Down syndrome
        diagnosis awareness"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  legislation  would  require the Department of Health to create a
Down syndrome awareness program by providing evidence-based  information
about  Down  syndrome to health care providers who order tests for preg-
nant women or infants to screen for Down syndrome.
 
  I support the goal of this legislation, which will ensure that  physi-
cians  who  treat  pregnant  women  and  infants have access to the most
current information on Down syndrome.  However,  technical  changes  are
necessary, including to the legislation's effective date, to ensure that
the  Department may comply with the legislation by posting such informa-
tion on its website and within an appropriate timeframe.
 
  I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang-
es.  On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Creates a Down syndrome awareness program to provide up-to-date and evidence-based information on Down syndrome to health care providers who order tests for a pregnant woman or infants to screen for Down syndrome.
title: Relates to Down syndrome diagnosis awareness
